items.what: tools/glref/gltrace/capture-qs.sh [NAME]: one command. It builds a recording libGL.so.1 and runs stock QuakeSpasm 0.96.3 under glref (Xvfb, the capture.c virtual clock) with timedemo demo1 at 320x240 windowed and the board's -heapsize 12288 -zone 384. Output: a binary trace of the load phase plus frames 100-139 and 400-439 (2 warm-up frames each; every other frame state-only), with a live RGB565 hash per full frame. The recorder is generated by gen.py from gl.h/glext.h/glx.h and the real library's nm -D: same export surface (checked), depth-0 recording, data by value with unpack-aware size rules, GetProcAddress returning its own wrappers, UNHANDLED for client arrays/glMap/GLSL (the capture fails if any appear). Knobs: QS_LIBGL (default /src/gl/out-host/libGL.so.1), QS_WINDOWS, QS_WARM, QS_GLENV, QS_REF=1.
items.decision: A wrapper libGL.so.1 first on LD_LIBRARY_PATH rather than an LD_PRELOAD, because SDL dlopen()s libGL and resolves everything through dlsym/glXGetProcAddressARB. Game dir gl/ref-apps/quake (gitignored pak0 + autoexec.cfg, no config.cfg). Traces live in gl/bench/qstrace/work/ (gitignored); work/qs -> p4final.
items.correctness: Tracer is transparent: glref's own capture of frame 439 without the tracer equals the tracer's live frame 439, 0/76800 px. Two captures are byte-identical except 2 of 689 glTexImage2D in frame 13 (QuakeSpasm's warp-image placeholders from hunk garbage, gl_model.c:585; overwritten by glCopyTexSubImage2D before use); all 84 frame hashes identical. 0 UNHANDLED.
items.perf: Capture ~9 s; trace 69.4 MB, 2,397,704 records, 439 frames (84 full, 355 state-only).

items.what: GL_ARB_multitexture with 2 units, advertised with GL_MAX_TEXTURE_UNITS=2. Covers glActiveTexture and glClientActiveTexture (plus ARB names), all glMultiTexCoord*, and per-unit enables, bindings, texenv, texgen and texture matrix (matrix_stack[3]). Also per-client-unit texcoord arrays, Push/PopAttrib and Push/PopClientAttrib per unit, display lists, queries and errors. Unit 1 also textures lines, points, smooth primitives, glBitmap and glDrawPixels. Unit 0 keeps its state in the original GLContext fields; unit 1's is GLContext.tu1, reached through tu_swap/tc_swap (gl/tinygl/source/s31_mtex.c).

items.what: gl/tinygl/source/zpipe_fused.c now has zf1_pick and 16 zf1_* fillers. zpf_select is called for every batch, not only two-unit ones. The fillers cover: status bar and view blend (SRC_ALPHA/ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA, using per-alpha 192 B MUL8 tables, and storing the texel directly when opaque); pictures and characters with alpha GREATER; fences with depth write; console (MODULATE SA/OMSA); water; alias case 2 (COMBINE MODULATE TEXTURE x PRIMARY x 2^s); particles (MODULATE RGBA SA/OMSA); glow (MODULATE ONE/ONE). For a Quake without multitexture they also cover the lightmap passes (DST_COLOR/SRC_COLOR and ZERO/SRC_COLOR) and both alias passes. Each filler runs the batch's own colour and texel stages, then one loop using zpipe_int.h arithmetic. For the REPLACE signatures, a level-0 REPEAT bilinear stage is replaced by zf_bil0_*, whose exact shortcuts fire when a weight is 0 or 32 (one row, one column, or one texel).
items.decision: On by default. S31GL_FUSED=0 gives the general path. s31gl_fused_stats now has 8 counters (s31gl.h updated).
items.correctness: fused_test: one scenario per signature under all 6 filters, both wraps, both shadings (the neighbour signature stays general) and opaque/translucent colour, with 1:1, 1.25:1 and half-texel HUD quads. 0 differing colour or depth values, host and RV32. Mutating either shortcut fails its scenarios.

items.what: zf_world_x is the filtered ZF_WORLD for GL_LINEAR lightmaps, both units REPEAT and depth LEQUAL+write. Once per chunk it reads which texel stage the per-triangle or per-block level choice placed and runs a dedicated loop: nearest in level 0 or d (one pass), NEAREST_MIPMAP_LINEAR (one pass), bilinear or trilinear (two passes: depth plus lightmap, then unit 0). The depth test comes first, so only passing fragments are sampled. Samples use the stages' own macros, now shared in the new s31_tfilt_int.h. A 2x2 square cache with one-multiply horizontal lerps is exact: a(32-w)+b w+SRND equals 32a+SRND+(b-a)w mod 2^32 and stays below 2^32. The lightmap hits the cache 79% of the time, and trilinear's finer level is sampled uncached. zpx_code2 now has the LML/NML level code inline. New direct runners zp_run_mt_direct and zp_run_lod_mt_direct (ZPipeX.run_mt, run_lod_mt, chunk) call the fused world filler without a depth-stage call or list walk; the nearest world filler uses the same path.
items.decision: Tier-1-style fused fillers for every QuakeSpasm texture mode, identical to the general path under the phase-4 R1 rules (level per triangle or per 8-pixel block, chosen by the unchanged code). The phase-4 filter arithmetic is unchanged, as bar 2 requires.
